ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, $C$ is a point on line segment $AB$, and $P$, $Q$ are the midpoints of line segments $AC$ and $BC$ respectively. If $PQ = 12$, find the length of $AB$.
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $P$ and $Q$ are the midpoints of line segments $AC$ and $BC$ respectively,\\
it follows that $AP=PC=\frac{1}{2}AC$ and $CQ=QB=\frac{1}{2}CB$,\\
since $PQ=PC+CQ=\frac{1}{2}AC+\frac{1}{2}CB=\frac{1}{2}AB=12$,\\
thus $AB=\boxed{24}$.
